corrections.old_text: ንድ ፡ ኤፌ ፡ ፭ ፡ ፲፭ ። ም ፡ ፻ ፡ ፲፰ ።
corrections.corrected_text: ንድ ፡ ኤፌ ፡ ፭ ፡ ፲፭ ። ም ፡ ፪ ፡ ፲፰ ።
corrections.reason: The chapter reference after ም (ምዕራፍ) is the numeral ፪ (Chapter 2, verse 18 of James), which was misread as ፻ (100).
Both visually on the page (6th-order ይ with its characteristic left loop) and in Ge'ez nominative syntax (ወኵሉ እኩይ ምግባር), the word is እኩይ.
The Ge'ez word is እወ ('yes', translated in the next line as እሺ በጀ የምታሰኝ), and the glyph on the page is clearly ወ rather than ሆ.
